children: State Street's SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust

, which tracks the S&P 500 Index, declared a quarterly distribution of $1.8888 per share, approx. 0.8% lower than the $1.9035 per share paid for the June 2026 quarter. SPY's March 2026 distribution was $1.797 per share.
The ETF's ex-dividend and record date is Sept. 18, while the distribution is scheduled to be paid on Oct. 30.
